links.outcome: AI quality-control accuracy on prospective temporal and external public datasets versus development performance
links.effect: Prospective temporally distinct set: 95.0% accuracy; external datasets (n=1,821 videos): 91.7% to 92.3% accuracy, a modest drop from internal performance.
links.quote: The system also showed robust generalizability from 91.7% to 92.3% accuracy across the publicly available external datasets and operated efficiently with a mean inference time of 303 ms per video, confirming its suitability for real-time clinical deployment.

unlisted_practices: Translating expert echocardiography quality criteria into an interpretable rules-based AI scoring rubric with domain-level feedback

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an AI system for real-time quality control of transthoracic echocardiography across prospective and external retrospective test sets. Despite 'deployment' in the title, validation is performed offline on video datasets without evaluating a comparative deployment practice.
